key_insight: Self-supervised learning on dense 3D zeolite representations achieves state-of-the-art adsorption-property prediction, including transfer to metal–organic frameworks.
engineering_relevance: Better predictions with limited property labels could help prioritize porous materials for gas storage, separations, and catalysis.
method: Pretrain self-supervised models on volumetric representations of all-silica zeolites.
Compare 3D pretraining with adapted image-pretrained models and out-of-domain volumetric pretraining.
Evaluate against hand-crafted descriptors and supervised baselines across training-set sizes.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covers six existing adsorption-property prediction tasks across training-set sizes, with learned features consistently outperforming hand-crafted descriptors and convolutional architectures generally outperforming vision transformers.
watch_item: Pretraining focuses on all-silica zeolites; transfer to metal–organic frameworks does not establish generalization across all porous-material chemistries.
paper_title: ZeoBench: A Benchmark for Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Zeolite Representations
